nf1bc10079a.headline: Chinese visitors down 56%, Japanese tourism still strong; Taiwanese, Korean, European and American travellers fill the gap | International
nf1bc10079a.summary: Chinese travel demand to Japan is weak as bilateral relations show no sign of improving, a Japanese media analysis reported. Japan hopes Taiwanese, Korean, European and American travellers will fill the gap.
nf1bc10079a.why: Inbound tourism spending supports Japanese hotels, retail and transport companies, so a drop in Chinese visitors affects their revenues. Japan's tourism sector is sensitive to diplomatic relations.

nd05ab8b71e.headline: Foxpost doubles its pace: new super machine at the Fót logistics center is ready
nd05ab8b71e.summary: Following the merger of Foxpost and Packeta, Hungary's largest parcel pickup network, an automated line capable of processing up to 14,000 parcels per hour has started operating in Fót.
nd05ab8b71e.why: Packeta is a parcel delivery and logistics operator whose capacity shapes e-commerce delivery costs in Central Europe.

nd05ab8b71e.original_headline: Megduplázza a tempót a Foxpost: elkészült a fóti logisztikai központ új szupergépe

nfa56ece30e.headline: Inflation in July is 2.3 percent, Macedonia is second in the region, says Mickoski
nfa56ece30e.summary: Inflation in North Macedonia stood at 2.3% year on year in July, while market retail prices rose 1.8%, placing the country second-lowest in the region, according to Prime Minister Christian Mickoski.
nfa56ece30e.why: Inflation data guides the National Bank of North Macedonia's policy decisions and affects the country's bond and currency markets.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

nb5f16684cd.headline: Selling a home is increasingly difficult | on average it takes almost six months
nb5f16684cd.summary: In Italy, the average time to sell a property has risen to about 5.5 months, an increase of 6% compared with the previous year.
nb5f16684cd.why: Property sale times are a gauge of housing market liquidity. They feed into construction activity, mortgage lending and household wealth.

nb5f16684cd.original_headline: Vendere casa è sempre più difficile | in media servono quasi sei mesi

n0fdc357b48.headline: Anger over One Nation plan to 'end compulsory super'
n0fdc357b48.summary: One Nation has been criticised after leader Pauline Hanson suggested many people would be better off without compulsory superannuation contributions. The proposal has drawn strong reaction in Australia.
n0fdc357b48.why: Compulsory superannuation is Australia's retirement savings system, a large pool of capital that affects markets and household finances.

n14d3e5ead4.headline: Salada reaping from efficiencies and market moves
n14d3e5ead4.summary: Salada Foods Jamaica reported net profit of $68.3 million for the three months to June 30, up 120% from a year earlier on stronger sales and wider margins.
n14d3e5ead4.why: Salada Foods is a Jamaican coffee and beverage manufacturer, so its margins and sales reflect local consumer demand and input costs.

nfc948b6a4b.headline: ‎Iran Offers $30,000 For Capturing, killing of US Soldiers
nfc948b6a4b.summary: Iran's military announced a $30,000 reward for anyone who kills or captures and hands over a United States soldier. The announcement is part of the ongoing tensions between Tehran and Washington.
nfc948b6a4b.why: Escalation between Iran and the United States affects oil supply risk, shipping routes and global risk sentiment. Energy markets react to threats in the Middle East.

nb8ba263f79.headline: Iran Incentivizes Capture or Elimination of U.S. Soldiers
nb8ba263f79.summary: Iran's top military official, Major General Amir Hatami, said any Iranian citizen who captures US soldiers would be rewarded, in a statement described as provocative.
nb8ba263f79.why: Threats against US forces raise regional security risk, which can weigh on oil prices and risk assets.

nd910cf4019.headline: Reserve Bank leaves low deposit lending rules unchanged as mortgage rates climb
nd910cf4019.summary: The Reserve Bank has kept its low-deposit lending limits unchanged, saying housing risks are contained. Rising mortgage rates are squeezing borrowers instead.
nd910cf4019.why: Loan-to-value limits set by the central bank restrict high-leverage mortgage lending and affect housing credit conditions.

n08037f02fa.headline: Government fixes LPG production targets for refiners, Reliance gets largest share
n08037f02fa.summary: India has set maximum LPG production targets for refineries and upstream companies to build a domestic buffer after import disruptions. Schedules will be reviewed every six months.
n08037f02fa.why: LPG is a key household and industrial fuel, and Reliance Industries is one of India's largest refiners and petrochemical producers.

n2afbe7f9ff.headline: ONGC gets US licence to resume full Venezuela operations, eyes operatorship
n2afbe7f9ff.summary: ONGC has received a US Treasury licence to resume full operations in Venezuela, removing sanctions-related risk. The company expects to recover pending dividends and may take operatorship of projects.
n2afbe7f9ff.why: ONGC is India's largest state-run oil and gas explorer, and ONGC Videsh is its overseas arm. Sanctions licences determine whether foreign producers can operate and get paid in Venezuela.

nddf5fe66c1.headline: Oil edges higher as Middle East tensions linger
nddf5fe66c1.summary: Traders are assessing renewed Israeli attacks on Lebanon and potential fresh US sanctions on Iran before the ceasefire formally ends.
nddf5fe66c1.why: Middle East conflict risk and sanctions on Iranian exports affect global crude supply expectations.
nddf5fe66c1.why_moved: Renewed attacks and possible new sanctions raise the risk of supply disruption.

nfb2cc066ea.headline: Pakistan's digital payments boom fails to break economy's dependence on cash
nfb2cc066ea.summary: Rapid growth in digital payments in Pakistan has not produced a meaningful reduction in the economy's reliance on cash, according to a report.
nfb2cc066ea.why: Cash dependence limits tax collection and formal lending, which affects the growth and financing prospects of emerging economies.

nf77724d171.headline: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
nf77724d171.summary: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia on Sunday, killing at least six people. It was described as one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.
nf77724d171.why: Attacks on Russian territory and infrastructure can affect energy markets, defence spending and the broader outlook for the war and sanctions.

n43662028ad.headline: What impact will July’s energy price hike have on UK inflation figures?
n43662028ad.summary: Many experts forecast UK Consumer Prices Index inflation will rise to 2.9% in July from 2.6% in June, reflecting a July energy price increase.
n43662028ad.why: CPI is the Bank of England's main inflation gauge, so the reading shapes expectations for interest-rate decisions and gilt yields.

n2155eb3c93.headline: Farmers foot march: Haryana seals Khanauri inter-state border point
n2155eb3c93.summary: Haryana Police set up multi-layer barricades at the Khanauri border point as farmers plan a 228-km foot march to Delhi against the proposed India-US trade deal.
n2155eb3c93.why: Farm policy and trade agreements affect agricultural prices, import competition and the political risk around India's trade commitments.

nec84b963d0.headline: Average LA, Orange County Gas Prices Holding Steady
nec84b963d0.summary: The average price of self-serve regular gasoline in Los Angeles County fell one-tenth of a cent to $5.645 a gallon. The average has dropped 6.9 cents over the past 13 days.
nec84b963d0.why: Gasoline prices reflect crude oil costs, refining margins and regional supply, and they feed into consumer spending and inflation.

ndd88d94731.headline: Slash immigration, blow the budget: Parkinson’s warning for both sides of politics
ndd88d94731.summary: Former Treasury head Martin Parkinson said slashing immigration would cost Australia growth and could also cost the budget surplus.
ndd88d94731.why: Immigration levels feed labour supply and tax revenue, which shape both economic growth and fiscal outcomes.

n1defdc2910.headline: Director faces investigations following Mundella collapse
n1defdc2910.summary: Liquidators are set to investigate possible insolvent trading and hundreds of potentially unreasonable transactions by the director of Mundella and associated companies, leaving unsecured creditors with nothing.
n1defdc2910.why: Insolvency investigations determine whether directors breached duties, which affects creditor recovery and corporate governance standards.

n518dab5972.headline: Fiscal cost of holding down fuel prices in India after West Asia war
n518dab5972.summary: A paper by ICRIER authors Sanjeev Gupta and Pratik Tiwary examines the fiscal cost to India of holding down fuel prices after the West Asia war.
n518dab5972.why: Fuel subsidies and price controls affect India's fiscal deficit, government borrowing and the sovereign bond market.

n8d2b70d07f.headline: 19 Sectors Beat Q1 Estimates, Nifty Profit Growth Hits 10-Quarter High
n8d2b70d07f.summary: Corporate Q1 FY27 earnings beat forecasts across 19 sectors, with Nifty profit after tax rising 18% to a 10-quarter high. Financials, metals and telecom drove the growth.
n8d2b70d07f.why: The Nifty 50 is India's benchmark index of large-cap companies, and strong earnings growth supports index valuations. Financials, metals and telecom are heavily weighted in the index.

n5b1893bd67.headline: 19 sectors beat estimates in Q1 as corporate earnings gain momentum: Report
n5b1893bd67.summary: A report says 19 sectors exceeded expectations in India's first-quarter FY27 corporate earnings, with financials among the strong performers. The performance was described as broad-based.
n5b1893bd67.why: Indian listed companies span banking, consumer and industrial sectors, so broad earnings beats tend to influence the Nifty and Sensex benchmarks.

neb2f43feb6.headline: US pulls last aircraft carrier in Asia as Trump focuses on Iran and Western Hemisphere
neb2f43feb6.summary: The US has withdrawn its last aircraft carrier from Asia as President Trump's war against Iran stretches U.S. carrier capacity. The western Pacific is left without a carrier.
neb2f43feb6.why: Aircraft carrier deployments signal US military commitments, and shifts in them can affect regional security, defense spending and energy-market risk premiums.

n0ed98be5fa.headline: Sales Rocket in a Burst of Tricolour
n0ed98be5fa.summary: Sales surged by up to 25% in value and 5-7% in volume compared with last year across categories during India's Independence Day period. Brands, retailers and e-commerce platforms all gained.
n0ed98be5fa.why: Festive and holiday sales are a key indicator of consumer demand in India, where household spending drives a large share of economic activity.

ndada2af870.headline: Haryana shopkeepers rejoice: PM-WANI will bring public Wi-Fi to shops... a new path to earnings opens
ndada2af870.summary: Under PM-WANI, grocery stores, cyber cafes and Common Service Centres in villages can become public internet access points, creating new earning opportunities.
ndada2af870.why: PM-WANI is a government program to expand public Wi-Fi access in India, which affects telecom data demand and small retail service revenue.

naf30d80fb1.headline: After ₹661 Crore Bank Scam, Haryana Government Gets Strict, Makes Major Announcement on Government Funds....
naf30d80fb1.summary: Amid a CBI probe into an alleged ₹661 crore financial scam involving IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank, Haryana has tightened monitoring of government money. The state finance department is involved in the measures.
naf30d80fb1.why: IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank are Indian lenders, so allegations involving them can affect investor confidence in bank governance and compliance. State deposit monitoring affects public-sector banking flows.

n43fea8e940.headline: "The most serious crisis since Iraq's invasion of the country in 1990": Blockade of the Strait of Hormuz paralyzes Kuwait, whose oil provides more than 90% of public revenues
n43fea8e940.summary: Kuwait remains paralysed six months into the Middle East conflict, unable to transport oil on which it depends for over 90% of public revenues. Iran has also regularly targeted the emirate with strikes.
n43fea8e940.why: Kuwait is a major OPEC crude producer, and its oil export revenue funds most of the state budget, so export disruption hits both its fiscal position and global crude supply.

nfc6df9ead4.headline: Iran Resumes Oil Loading From Kharg Island... What Do Satellite Images Reveal?
nfc6df9ead4.summary: Satellite images showed Iranian oil loading resumed at Kharg Island on August 14 after two weeks of suspension. A large tanker carrying about 2 million barrels was loaded at the Azadegan berth.
nfc6df9ead4.why: Kharg Island is Iran's main crude export terminal, so loading activity there is a direct indicator of Iranian oil supply reaching global markets.

nfb4dc1bfd4.headline: Media Learn of Shadow Oil Flows Through Hormuz
nfb4dc1bfd4.summary: Media reports show hidden oil exports from the Middle East kept global prices significantly lower than expected at the start of the war. The flows were not visible in official data.
nfb4dc1bfd4.why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity, and unreported supply flows can distort price expectations and inventory estimates.

n20ebb09947.headline: Kuwait gold rides global wave to KD 43.6
n20ebb09947.summary: Gold prices in Kuwait rose last week in line with gains in global markets. The 24-karat price reached around KD 43.6 per gram.
n20ebb09947.why: Gold is a widely held store of value, and its price tends to reflect global risk sentiment and currency moves.

n72124ba652.headline: New Zealand’s a2 Milk tumbles on weak earnings forecast, profit miss
n72124ba652.summary: a2 Milk forecast weak annual earnings after missing market expectations for fiscal 2026, citing supply-chain disruption in its China-label business. Its shares fell more than 10%.
n72124ba652.why: a2 Milk is a New Zealand-listed dairy company selling infant formula and milk products, with significant exposure to China.
n72124ba652.why_moved: The company forecast weak annual earnings after missing expectations, citing supply-chain disruption in its China-label business.

nfc75eaeb83.headline: Market recap: Top 5 firms lose Rs 1 lakh crore in market value; TCS, Reliance suffer biggest hit
nfc75eaeb83.summary: Sensex fell 489.92 points, or 0.62%, and Nifty lost 204.65 points, or 0.83%, in the week. Five of India's 10 most valued firms lost nearly Rs 1 lakh crore in market capitalisation, with TCS suffering the steepest decline.
nfc75eaeb83.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indexes of India's National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange. TCS and Reliance are among the country's largest listed companies and heavily weighted in these indexes.
nfc75eaeb83.why_moved: Five of India's top 10 firms lost nearly Rs 1 lakh crore in market value, with TCS posting the steepest decline during the week.

ndeaeb83261.headline: DroneShield Stock: Revenue Forecast Raised to 270 Million
ndeaeb83261.summary: DroneShield raised its revenue forecast to AUD 250-270 million. The company said order volume is growing significantly despite ASIC investigations and share price losses.
ndeaeb83261.why: DroneShield is an Australian-listed maker of counter-drone defence technology, so its revenue outlook reflects demand for defence products.

n96078dff15.headline: Pressure on the restaurant sector in 2026: Turnover falls due to inflation too
n96078dff15.summary: Greek restaurant turnover is falling in 2026 as consumers cut back on dining out amid rising living costs. Inflation is cited as a factor in the decline.
n96078dff15.why: Restaurant spending is a sensitive indicator of household consumption, which makes up a large share of Greece's economy. Weaker demand affects hospitality companies and tourism-linked businesses.
